subject: general
question: Electromagnet is formed on _______.

options.text: By passing current through a coil coiled around a glass rod
Placing a magnet near a current carrying conductor
the current passing through the magnet
To pass current through a coil wound around a soft iron core

solution:
The correct answer is __**To pass current through a coil wound around a soft iron core**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• An electromagnet is created by passing an electric current through a coil of wire that is wound around a soft iron core.
 
• The soft iron core becomes magnetized when the current flows through the coil, enhancing the magnetic field produced by the coil.
 
• Electromagnets are temporary magnets, which means they only exhibit magnetic properties when an electric current is applied.
 
• Electromagnets can be turned on and off and their strength can be adjusted by changing the amount of electric current flowing through the coil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electromagnetism**

 
 
• Electromagnetism is the interaction of electric currents or fields and magnetic fields.
 
• It is one of the four fundamental forces of nature, along with gravity, weak nuclear force, and strong nuclear force.
 
• The field of electromagnetism studies the interactions between electrically charged particles and the electromagnetic fields they produce.
 
 
 
• **Soft Iron Core**
 
 
• A soft iron core is used in electromagnets to enhance the magnetic field generated by the coil.
 
• Soft iron is preferred because it has high magnetic permeability, allowing it to easily become magnetized and demagnetized.
 
• This property makes it ideal for applications where the magnetic field needs to be switched on and off frequently.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Electromagnets**
 
 
• Electromagnets are widely used in various applications such as electric bells, loudspeakers, relays, and magnetic cranes.
 
• They are also crucial components in many modern technologies, including MRI machines in medical imaging and particle accelerators in physics research.
 
 
 
• **Adjusting Electromagnet Strength**
 
 
• The strength of an electromagnet can be adjusted by changing the number of coils or the amount of current flowing through the coil.
 
• Increasing the number of coils or the current will increase the strength of the magnetic field.
 
• This property allows for precise control of the magnetic force exerted by the electromagnet.
